summary.text: Laura Kimble is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates from District 71, listed with Harrison County. Her legislative page lists her as chair of the Legal Services Committee.

paragraphs.text: Kimble's page lists her education as Washington Irving High School and a B.A. in international studies from West Virginia University, and names her spouse as Jeffrey Kimble.
Her affiliations include the Harrison County Republican Executive Committee, the Harrison County Republican Club and the National Rifle Association.
Kimble also serves on the House's Education, Educational Choice and Judiciary committees.
